name: PowOS system module
purpose: Magisk module: PowOS.apk as a privileged system app + its permissions, the recents overlay, the containers kernel's nftables modules, the split screen orientation list (split-orientation.sh: /system_ext/oplus/sys_wms_split_app_ps.xml + <vSplit> per installed app), a two-strike boot watchdog
installedBy: the module zip (targets/android/system-module), installed with rooted.sh module (pushed to /data/local/tmp, magisk --install-module, then deleted), active after a reboot
remove_note: the module package's own removal (Magisk's remove marker) is the uninstall; it is gone at the next boot
